name: recommendBook
intent: Record the selected user's book recommendation with the supplied bibliographic details.
pre: A user with the supplied uid exists.
No book recommendation with the supplied callNo exists.
post: Set the recommendation's call number to callNo.
Set the recommendation's title to title.
Set the recommendation's edition to edition.
Set the recommendation's author to author.
Set the recommendation's publisher to publisher.
Set the recommendation's description to description.
Set the recommendation's ISBN to isbn.
Set the recommendation date to today.
Link the recommendation to the selected user.
Add the recommendation to the user's recommendations.
Store the new recommendation among the system's book recommendations.
difficulty_basis: New recommendation with date, bibliographic fields and user association/membership.
conflicts: Negative Jest passes numeric 99 for preserved String uid. No input-type correction performed.
scenarios: All supplied fields/date/user link/user collection/stored record/result checked.

effects_audit: Uniqueness is among all recommendations by callNo, not per user or by ISBN. No BookCopy creation or publication validation inferred.
